info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Facility Utilities Administration-spec
info.description: The Facility Utilities Administration API enables users to manage and oversee utility services associated with various facilities. Through this API, stakeholders such as facility managers and administrators can effectively create new utility records, ensuring accurate tracking and management of resources. This includes operations related to utility providers, service types, and billing details essential for operational efficiency. Ideal for integration within banking applications, this API facilitates seamless interactions with utility service management systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new entry for utilities administration, which involves managing and coordinating various utility services in a facility. Ensure you provide all necessary details in the request body to successfully register the entry.
